hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE 'frontend/.*\.ts$' && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>&1 | head -20 || true
(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE 'frontend/.*\.(ts|html)$' && cd frontend && npx ng lint --lint-file-patterns="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -30) || true
echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '(\.env|package-lock\.json)' && echo 'BLOCK: sensitive file' && exit 1 || exit 0
